verdict.rationale: Streaming live meeting audio out to a transcription or realtime model endpoint is a fair question for a real-time communications SDK. However, the evidence pack only covers audio publishing and encoding, content sharing into meetings, data messages, and PSTN/SIP features. Nothing documents live transcription or exporting session audio to an external endpoint while the session is running.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, live session audio can be streamed to a transcription or realtime model endpoint while the session is running
